deviations: Board choice: SH-6 (§4 L186) names no page. The band reads the route §4 L166 draws (Users), the PageHeader is SCR-121's (§7 L294: 'Users', meta.asof, '+ Invite user') and the route content, CMP-087's children, is one neutral color.surface.canvas placeholder with no text, as board 05 (SH-5, the other (b) state) draws it, so 05 and 06 differ only at the band's right end (and, until e42kit draws it, at the Admin entry's DS-2 edge: see the local helpers). SCR-121's own states are boards 30-41 and 95, and §1 gives no last sign-in or display name for its rows, so a populated grid here would need invented cells.

Board choice: the strip is empty and reads strip.none on one line (§4 L186): §1's worked example raises no strip item (users.without_mfa 0, the tier recorded, no key, drift, tamper, withdrawal, backup or break-glass fact), as OV-2 draws strip.none when every read is ok (L275).
The placeholder's height is <main>'s remaining height (estimated, floored: 480 / 1120 px, as on board 05); it is vs fill, so the live relayout sizes it between the PageHeader and the footer marker.
No focus ring is drawn: SH-6 has no focus moment (focus never moves on a route change, §4 L200).

Buttons, chips, badges, banners, fields, tiles, tables, menus and dialogs are compositions from tokens: admin controls are 32 px (size.control.comfortable, §4 L176) while the library CMP-001 binds size.control.height (24 px in the file's compact density), and cvsheet v1 cannot set an instance's glyph, fill or border.

TopBar, NavRail, RightRail and StatusBar content other than the Admin entry, the env badges and the owner's name is drawn as neutral placeholders (E10-D02 owns it; §1 L97 gives only the sizes). Chrome surface (kit-level, review r1 finding 5, correcting e42kit's 'no source names a chrome surface'): `15` names one per part, color.surface.raised for CMP-071 NavRail and CMP-072 TopBar (15:699, :708) and CMP-209 RightRail (15:2421), color.surface.sunken for CMP-208 StatusBar (15:2411). The boards depart from it and draw all four on color.surface.app, CMP-070 AppShell's surface (15:690), with color.border.subtle dividers, because D03 takes only E10's sizes (§1 L97) and draws the chrome's content as placeholders; E10-D02, the shell D03 consumes, is greyscale with no bespoke colour and leaves the token pass to E10-D03 (E10:20-21; no E10-D03 doc at 782eb0e4d); §15 measures no pair on the chrome; and one chrome on every kit board keeps the 103 boards comparable. Binding `15`'s surfaces is a kit change that regenerates every board (routed to the kit owner). On color.surface.app the chrome's pairs pass: the env badge's LIVE border 4.94 / 5.20 / 4.94 (measured from token-sync.json with §15's WCAG formula, which reproduces §15's 6.29, 5.62, 3.98 and 4.42) and its word 16.06 / 17.99 / 18.18 (§15 L638); the current Admin entry's DS-2 edge 6.29 / 6.81 / 12.54 (§15 L635).

Local helper (kit-level, review r1 finding 1): e42kit's _admin_entry marks the current Admin entry by its color.surface.selected fill alone, 1.58 / 1.40 against the rail (color.surface.app, dark / light; measured from token-sync.json), a state under AC-5's UI bar of 3.0 (§15 L620). D03 takes DS-2 over from D02 unchanged (L17-18; D02:1169), and DS-2 binds color.border.admin to 'the 4 px rule and the current nav entry's edge' (D02:1003); §2 D2 (L115) names the band's two tokens and does not drop the edge. So board 06 draws it: color.text.tertiary (DS-2's fallback) at border.thick (D02 gives no width), inner; 6.29 / 6.81 / 12.54 against the rail (§15 L635, L638) and 3.98 / 4.86 / 7.94 against the fill (§15 L656, where F4's FAIL is the 4.5 text bar; an edge is UI, bar 3.0). Boards 00-07, 09 and 10 draw the fill alone until e42kit draws the edge (routed to the kit owner).

Local helper (kit-level, review r1 finding 6): three kit compositions take the build notes' '<CMP id> <Name> (composition)' names: 'CMP-209 RightRail (composition)' (kit: 'RightRail (composition)'; 15:2416), 'primary action · CMP-001 Button (composition)' (kit: 'primary action'; 15:48) and 'CMP-093 AuditActionTrigger (composition) · footer marker' (kit: 'footer marker (CMP-093)'; 15:893). The other boards keep the kit's names until e42kit renames them.
Board names carry Penpot's normalised ' / ' form (E42-D03 / 31 SCR-121 / populated · …) so cvsheet's find-or-create root matches on every section call; §0 L46-47 writes 'SCR-121/populated'.
